text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, such as a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of the system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early and design better solutions. Good testing gives developers confidence. When tests pass, they know their changes have not broken anything. This confidence allows teams to improve their code and release new versions more safely and quickly.
